lesson.meaning: To successfully complete something, especially a task or goal.
examples: I hope to accomplish all my urgent tasks before the end of the day.
Our team worked hard to accomplish the project goals ahead of schedule.
What do you aim to accomplish in your new role with the company?
With dedication, you can accomplish anything you set your mind to.
We need a clear strategy to accomplish these sales targets by next quarter.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, to 'accomplish' is to finish something successfully, like crossing the finish line of a race!
